description: Redesign the homepage sections to be more visually distinctive, modern, and advanced. The homepage should stand out as the main entry point of the site with unique interactive elements, a compelling visual layout, portfolio/case studies section, and more refined design that represents the whole brand.
steps: Redesign homepage/sections/01-hero.html: Make it visually distinct from service page heroes. Add a unique animated gradient mesh background (different from the simple aurora used on service pages). Add a floating services orbit/carousel around the central mockup. Enhance the 3D mockup with richer content showing multiple services. Make the badge more distinctive with a pulsing gradient ring.

Redesign homepage/sections/03-services-overview.html: Create a visually compelling Bento grid layout that shows all 4 services with distinct icons, hover animations, and mini-previews. Each card should have a unique gradient accent and animated hover state. Make it immediately clear what each service offers.

Add a new section homepage/sections/04-portfolio.html: A portfolio/case studies section showing actual results with before/after metrics, client logos, and category filters. Use a modern card-based layout with glassmorphism effects.

Redesign homepage/sections/06-stats.html: Make the stats section more visually impressive with large animated counters, progress rings or bar charts, a comparison element (before vs after), and glowing accent colors. Add subtle particle effects or animated connecting lines between stats.

Redesign homepage/sections/04-why-us.html: Rename/move existing 04-why-us to 05-why-us to accommodate the new portfolio section. Update with more interactive tabs, animated transitions, and visual proof points.
Update homepage/sections/05-process.html (becomes 06-process.html): Update the numbering and add more visual flair with animated connecting lines and step progression indicators.

Renumber all homepage sections to accommodate the new portfolio section: 01-hero, 02-trust-strip, 03-services-overview, 04-portfolio (NEW), 05-why-us, 06-process, 07-stats, 08-testimonials, 09-faq, 10-cta.
Update homepage/preview-all-sections.html to include all sections in the correct new order with the new portfolio section.
acceptance_criteria: Homepage has 10 sections instead of 9 (new portfolio section added)
Hero section has distinct visual elements not found on service page heroes (gradient mesh, services orbit)
Portfolio/case studies section shows results with metrics
Stats section has animated counters with visual enhancements (progress rings or animated bars)
Services section has compelling Bento grid with distinct card designs for each service
All HTML files are valid and use consistent class naming (vs-home-*)
preview-all-sections.html includes all 10 sections in order
All sections use RTL direction and Vazirmatn font
verification: Check that homepage/sections/ contains 10 HTML files with correct numbering
Check that homepage/preview-all-sections.html references all 10 sections
Verify all HTML files have proper RTL direction and font-family declarations
findings: Successfully implemented all homepage redesign changes. 10 sections verified with RTL, Vazirmatn font, and vs-home-* naming. Hero uses conic-gradient mesh (distinct from service page aurora blobs). Portfolio section has 6 cards with filter tabs. Stats section has SVG progress rings and before/after comparison bars.
